mapper.sql: t.* , prod_order.order_no AS prod_order_no , work_order.work_order_no AS work_order_no , op_task.task_no AS op_task_no , op_task.op_name AS op_name , from_op_task.task_no AS from_op_task_no , to_op_task.task_no AS to_op_task_no

FROM mes_wip_txn t LEFT JOIN mes_prod_order prod_order ON prod_order.id = t.prod_order_id AND prod_order.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_work_order work_order ON work_order.id = t.work_order_id AND work_order.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_op_task op_task ON op_task.id = t.op_task_id AND op_task.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_op_task from_op_task ON from_op_task.id = t.from_op_task_id AND from_op_task.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_op_task to_op_task ON to_op_task.id = t.to_op_task_id AND to_op_task.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY t.txn_time DESC, t.id DESC
